what: independent verification of the four arXiv references in Hard_Zeta_AU2d_Literature_Notes_v0.1.md
method: each abstract page fetched and read; title, authors and the specific claims the notes attribute to it checked against it. Nothing here is a judgement about the mathematics in those papers -- only about whether the citation says what the notes say it says.

references.cited_as: Olivier Rozier, Parity sequences of the 3x+1 map on the 2-adic integers and Euclidean embedding
references.note: abstract carries 'a new formula for the inverse transform' and a plane embedding with affine self-similarity

references.cited_as: Oliver Kramer, Adaptive Search in Collatz Exponent-Code Space via 2-adic and 3-adic Constraints
references.note: the disclaimer is verbatim: 'not a verification method for the Collatz conjecture, but a symbolic diagnostic approach'

references.cited_as: Olivier Rozier and Claude Terracol, Paradoxical behavior in Collatz sequences
references.note: abstract: sequences 'whose first term is unexpectedly exceeded, given the proportion of odd terms'

references.cited_as: Tong Niu, Parity vectors and paradoxical sequences in the accelerated Collatz map
references.withdrawal_reason_as_stated: later work by Rozier and Terracol had already enumerated the relevant data
references.note: every claim the notes attribute to it is present and verbatim -- including the disclaimer. The issue is only that the paper is withdrawn and the notes list it as a primary reference without saying so. The withdrawal points at arXiv:2502.00948, which the notes ALREADY cite.
references.why_not_load_bearing: A-U.2e.4 section 12 and A-U.2d section 21 both state explicitly that they do NOT elevate Niu's numerical observation to a theorem, and derive the Farey / Stern-Brocot geometry from the integer determinant instead. No theorem in either round rests on it.

findings: 3 of 4 references are live and say what the notes say they say.
arXiv:2605.13886 (Niu) is WITHDRAWN as of 2026-05-20 and is listed as a primary reference without that being noted.
The withdrawal reason names Rozier-Terracol, which the notes already cite, so the fix is one line and no mathematics moves.
what_this_does_not_check: whether the mathematics in any of the four papers is correct
whether the notes' summary of each paper is complete
arXiv listings can change; this is a reading on the date above
